title.zh: 跨境DIY插珠帐篷拼搭套装

summary.zh:
这是一款面向跨境渠道的儿童DIY插珠帐篷拼搭套装，采用PP材质与拼装积木结构，适合在家庭互动、课堂活动和派对空间中搭建城堡与帐篷造型。

产品品牌为尧顺，原产地中国，覆盖多区域出口市场，支持视频导购与自有品牌授权，定位外贸供货。
summary.en:
This is an export-oriented DIY fort building set for kids, using PP material and a modular assembly structure. It is suitable for building castle and tent shapes in home interaction, classroom activities, and party-space setups.

Brand: Yaoshun. Origin: China. The product is targeted at multiple overseas markets, supports guide video usage and own-brand authorization, and is positioned for export supply.

zh: 该款跨境DIY插珠帐篷拼搭套装采用杆件与连接球组合设计，可快速搭建帐篷、房屋、城堡等多种结构，适合儿童在室内外进行创意拼搭与协作游戏。
产品材质为PP，支持反复拆装和形态重构。通过拼装过程可用于动手训练、空间认知和亲子互动，适合家庭零售与教育活动配套使用。
该商品主要面向外贸渠道，覆盖非洲、欧洲、南美、东南亚、北美、东北亚和中东等市场。支持导购视频与品牌授权信息，可用于跨境电商上架与项目采购。
en: This export DIY fort set uses a rod-and-connector design to quickly build tents, houses, castles, and other structures, making it suitable for children’s creative construction and collaborative play indoors or outdoors.

The product is made of PP and supports repeated assembly and shape reconfiguration. The building process can be used for hands-on practice, spatial learning, and parent-child interaction in both home retail and educational setups.

This item is mainly positioned for export channels across Africa, Europe, South America, Southeast Asia, North America, Northeast Asia, and the Middle East. Guide videos and own-brand authorization details are included for cross-border e-commerce listing and project procurement.
